Agde le août 1940
Ordre de mission

a

translated_text: Adam Agde, August 1940. Mission Order: Private Robert Zweigenthal is to travel to Béziers and Pézenas on August 1940 to go with his wife to the maternity hospital. He must return to camp by midnight on August 7th. Company Commander Lt. J. Bernary
